title: FixResult
description: What a fix Smith writes to /work/out/result.json (engine/README.md, "Fix and Propose a fix"). The engine checks it (ReadResultDelegate) before its own rules; the Smith checks it with check-result fix. Strict types where the engine branches, any non-empty JSON where it only passes content on.

outcome.description: The remedy from the menu: retry (the engine retries the incident) or unfixable. Branched on by the engine.

content.description: Passed on to a brief or a GitHub comment, never branched on: any non-empty JSON. A string is shown as itself; an object or array as a fenced JSON block.
